text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Alright, delegation members. We are finally departing for Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Did everyone remember all their stuff...?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I guess that's fine. It's a big city over there,
and besides, I have friends there too.
A total of four gathered at the airport: Rulership, Buena Vista, Victoire Pisa, and Transcend.

Transcend is a powerhouse on dirt
and an informant Umamusume with a worldwide network.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's certainly rewarding, without a doubt.
Though along with that comes the pressure...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed...
I am seen as representing the country, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, no need to psych yourself out.
This challenge carries our fate, but what we have to do in the end is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —It's a game.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: A game...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it's easy to get swayed by grand causes, but what we have to do doesn't change.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Factor in the enemy units' stats, terrain effects,
and track traits, then aim for victory.
In other words—a game.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Even facing the world's greatest, there is no need to flinch.
No matter how unfavorable the board may seem—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We can turn the tables depending on our strategy.
The most important thing for that is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: To have fun.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Have fun...?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, enjoying the act of play
is the true wellspring of rich inspiration."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
When things get strangely serious,
I lose my emotional balance and fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Don't take it so seriously. Racing is "entertainment,"
nothing more and nothing less.
If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It'd be a waste not to enjoy ourselves, wouldn't it? Being invited to Dubai means the god of entertainment has chosen us.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
This race is not a battle
fought for national prestige—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: It's the "World Championship" of the most fascinating game.

In the past, it might have been dismissed as the ramblings of a gamer.
However—
It's different now. Having treated races as a game and produced results, her words carried undeniable weight.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san... thank you.
Somehow, the unnecessary tension just faded away.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I had hoped to make up for my loss in Dubai last year,
but I will take a leaf out of your book
when it comes to having fun!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. We know all too well
how strong you truly are, Ruler.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
As long as you understand.
Now then, Trainer, let us depart.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave leading the group to you.
We shall surely bring back the golden trophy.
And then—we arrived at our destination.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Adjustments are—going according to plan.
Having Transcend-san here really makes a big difference.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you handling the information gathering, I can focus entirely on planning and execution.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I really appreciate the help even though we're in different races.
Yeah, thanks for helping me even though we're in different races!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmm, so first Ruler-chan races on her own, and then the three of us go afterwards... got it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's all about give-and-take in this world.
Leave the backup to me.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Everything is going smoothly...
No Umamusume in the world can surpass me in strategy."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The throne of the ruler is right before our eyes.
It's been a long road to get here, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, we've overcome so many hardships.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: A tiny border nation... Somehow trying to cling on against peers boasting overwhelming initial stats...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san gave me nothing but lectures.
Even so, I established a style of my own—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To think I've reached the point where I can
fight side-by-side with the Queen, Buena Vista...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just a little further, Trainer.
No matter how grand the stage,
we—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Win while enjoying it, as if playing a game."
That is precisely the ideal ruler
we board gamers envision.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Such a being is finally coming into existence!
Now is the time—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Dance, world—in the palm of my hand.
Nothing stood in the way of the dream—or so it was supposed to be.

The campaign to conquer the Twinkle Series.
This was supposed to be the final bastion.
However—

A board game presupposes a stable board state.
Yet the board state that was supposed to be immovable—
—It was not absolute.
